Nvidia's Megatron-LM (Shoeybi, Catanzaro et al., 17 September 2019) split a single Transformer layer's matrices across GPUs — tensor parallelism — to train an 8.3B model; Microsoft's ZeRO (October 2019) sharded optimizer state, gradients and parameters across data-parallel workers and shipped as DeepSpeed, producing Turing-NLG (17B, 13 February 2020). properties.subtitle: Neuronlike reinforcement learning, TD(lambda) and self-play gammon, 1982–1998
properties.one_line: The reinforcement learning wing of 1980s connectionism. Andrew Barto, Richard Sutton, and Charles Anderson introduced actor-critic architectures with associative search elements (1983). Sutton formalized temporal-difference learning methods (TD(lambda), 1988), and Chris Watkins formulated Q-learning for Markov decision processes (1989).
